question: Who became the first Vice-Chancellor of Jawaharlal Nehru University in 1969?
solution:
The correct answer is __**G Parthasarathi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** G Parthasarathi:-**

 
 
• He was the first Vice-Chancellor of Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) in 1969.
 
• JNU was established in 1966 and G Parthasarathi played a significant role in shaping the university.
 
• Prior to his appointment as Vice-Chancellor, G Parthasarathi had served as India's ambassador to the United States.
 
• He was also a renowned scholar and had authored several books on international relations and foreign policy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BD Nagchaudhuri:-**

 
 
• He was the second Vice-Chancellor of JNU, succeeding G Parthasarathi in 1972.
 
 
 
• **Y Nayudamma:-**
 
 
• ​Y Nayudamma was a scientist.
 
 
 
• **​KR Narayanan:-**
 
 
• KR Narayanan was the President of India from 1997-2002.
